encoder.trainable_scope: rank-window LoRA on final transformer block query/value projections plus 2-class head

split_protocol: grouped stratified 20-fold split: 14 folds train, 3 validation, 3 test; exact duplicate messages kept in one split

configuration.validation_selection: for each maximum client rank, select the smallest feasible rank/window within 0.002 macro-F1 of best validation macro-F1
configuration.training_feature_cache: frozen encoder prefix features computed after seeded client partitioning and cached separately per client partition; reused across strategies

resource_accounting.counts: only trainable LoRA and classifier-head coordinates in each recorded client window
resource_accounting.resource_scope: adapter/head communication only; the frozen BERT-Tiny backbone remains stored and executed
resource_accounting.correction: FedAvg and FedProx update full rank-4 adapters; heterogeneous strategies update ranks recorded in each round manifest

client_partition_note: Seeded Dirichlet partitioning induces both label skew and substantial quantity skew; per-client ham/spam counts and size CV are reported per run.

postprocessing.purpose: verify data partition hashes and correct active-update accounting from saved per-round rank windows
